headline: Mercy Leads Late Wires as Berm Cools
war_summary: Since the morning edition Palantine Berm has eased to three changes in two hours though fifty-three in the day about Vendett, Windburn Landing and the Pippeli Stones keep it busiest, now standing four Warden to three Colonial with no neutral ground, while Weathered Expanse has likewise cooled to three in two hours and twenty-seven in the day at Crow's Nest, Spirit Watch and Wightwalk, holding three Warden, four Colonial and two neutral amid day losses above eleven thousand Colonial and thirteen thousand Warden. Linn Mercy now files the sharpest late wires with four changes in two hours and twenty-four in the day at Outwich Ranch and Lathair, showing eight Colonial and three neutral with no Warden holding and day losses above eleven thousand Colonial and nineteen thousand Warden. Marban Hollow stirs anew with one late change and twenty-six in the day centered on Checkpoint Bua for one Warden, six Colonial and one neutral, Nevish Line and Mooring County report no change in two hours, and Stonecradle adds two late changes at Trammel Pool.
